column1: # Prebuilt engines (scripts/fetch-engine.sh), after Ardia's model: the engine
# key (scripts/engine-key.sh: the git trees of CHROMIUM_VERSION, args,
# patches, and //pane), the GitHub release whose assets carry
# PaneCore-<chromium>-<key:12>.zip, and the archive's SHA-256. A release
# that changes the engine adds a line: scripts/publish-engine.sh publishes
# the archive as a prerelease named engine-<key:12>, which the update check,
# reading the latest release, never sees, then adds it.
